--- name: autoDetectWelcomeSkill description: Sends the chat welcome message once per conversation. ---
# Auto Detect
Sends the chat welcome message once per conversation.
## When to use
- First step of a chat assistant.
## How it works
1. If `sentwelcome` is not set, marks the agent message completed and renders the `chat_detection_welcome` template. 2. Sets `sentwelcome` so it is only sent once.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `sentwelcome`: Set after the first run. When present, no welcome is sent
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The welcome response, and `sentwelcome=true`
## Implementation
- Bean `autoDetectWelcomeSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AutoDetectWelcomeSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: welcomeMenuSkill description: Shows a welcome menu listing the chat scenarios under the same automation label as the running scenario. ---
# Welcome Menu
Shows a welcome menu listing the chat scenarios under the same automation label as the running scenario.
## When to use
- The `<scenarioid>_welcome` step of a `welcome_menu_<labelid>` scenario.
## How it works
1. Reads `connectedtop` (the automationlabel id) from the running scenario. 2. Finds enabled, visible, chat-enabled scenarios with the same `connectedtop`, sorted by `ordering`, excluding itself. 3. Renders the `welcome_menu` template with `menuscenarios` and `menulabel`.
## Outputs
- The rendered menu response, `menuscenarios` and `menulabel`
## Implementation
- Bean `welcomeMenuSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.WelcomeMenuSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: renderLocalTemplateSkill description: Renders the local chat template named after the current automation step and sends it as the reply. ---
# Render Local Template
Renders the local chat template named after the current automation step and sends it as the reply.
## When to use
- The reply is fixed content, such as menus, help text or confirmations, that needs no LLM call.
## How it works
1. Uses the current automation step's id as the template name. 2. Renders it with the `localrender` connection and sets it as the last response.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The rendered response
## Implementation
- Bean `renderLocalTemplateSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.RenderLocalTemplateSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: libraryCollectionChatMonitorSkill description: Reads each new team chat message, asks the LLM whether and how the assistant should help, and schedules a follow-up. ---
# Monitor Chats
Reads each new team chat message, asks the LLM whether and how the assistant should help, and schedules a follow-up.
## When to use
- The assistant should watch a team chat quietly and step in only when it is useful.
## How it works
1. Loads the user message this step is replying to and stores it as `userquery`. 2. Calls the `library_collection_chat_monitor` tools function on the thinking LLM, which ranks the most likely `menuscenarios`, picks a `helperrole` and a `wait_minutes` (0–5). 3. Sleeps `wait_minutes` on its own thread. Nothing is broadcast while it waits. 4. A newer user message in the same channel cancels the wait, and that message is checked instead. If the wait finishes and no newer message arrived, it renders `chat_monitor_menu` with the recommended scenarios.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `startup_scenario`, `userquery`, `menuscenarios`, `recommendedscenarios`, `helperrole`, `confirmation`, `instruction`
## Implementation
- Bean `libraryCollectionChatMonitorSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.LibraryCollectionChatMonitorSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: chatMonitorResponseSkill description: Runs the scenario step the user chose in chat. ---
# Respond to Chats
Runs the scenario step the user chose in chat.
## When to use
- After the user picks one of the assistant's suggested actions.
## How it works
1. Sets `messagereload` to false. 2. Requires `selectedscenario` in the form `scenario.step`, and logs an error if it is missing or malformed. 3. Runs that scenario step with the current context.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `selectedscenario`: The step to run, as `scenarioid.stepid` - `entityid`: Optional entity the request is about
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- Whatever the selected step produces
## Implementation
- Bean `chatMonitorResponseSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.ChatMonitorResponseSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: openCodeJobCreatorSkill description: Plans a multi-step agent job from a user request by choosing among the documented skills and scenarios. ---
# Create Agent Jobs
Plans a multi-step agent job from a user request by choosing among the documented skills and scenarios.
## When to use
- A user asks for something that may take several skills to complete.
## How it works
1. Uses `query`, or the user's non-agent messages in the channel history. 2. Finds candidate skills and scenarios by searching the embedded `markdowncontent` of `aiskill` and `automationscenario` records. 3. Builds possible steps from each candidate's `markdowncontent`, `parameters` and `defaultoutput`, and calls the `agentJobCreator` structure. 4. If the user has not approved yet, shows the proposed plan (`agent_job_showjobplan`) and waits. 5. Once approved, saves the `agentjob` and its `agentjobstep` records and fires `agentjob/runagentjobs`.
## Inputs
- `query`: The user's request. Built from the channel history when missing - `channelchathistory`: Chat history used when `query` is not set
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `agentjob`, `proposedsteps`, `userapproved`, `possible_steps`
## Notes
- This skill reads `markdowncontent` and `parameters` from every aiskill row to pick tools, so keep them accurate.
## Implementation
- Bean `openCodeJobCreatorSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.OpenCodeJobCreatorSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: agentJobStatusSkill description: Shows the progress of a running agent job and checks again until it completes. ---
# Agent Job Status
Shows the progress of a running agent job and checks again until it completes.
## When to use
- After an agent job has been started from chat.
## How it works
1. Reloads the `agentjob` and renders `agent_job_showjobplan` with its timing. 2. While the status is not `complete` or `error`, broadcasts the status with `processUpdate` and checks again every 5 seconds on the same thread. Gives up after 500 checks. 3. When the job is finished, returns to `startup_scenario`.
## Inputs
- `agentjob`: The agent job to report on - `startup_scenario`: The step to return to when the job finishes
## Outputs
- `agentjob`, `secondstaken`, and the rendered status
## Implementation
- Bean `agentJobStatusSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AgentJobStatusSkill` - Agent type: `eventagent`

--- name: questionsSkill description: Starts a Q&A chat about one entity, offering saved suggestions or creating new ones. ---
# Questions Chat
Starts a Q&A chat about one entity, offering saved suggestions or creating new ones.
## When to use
- A user opens the question chat on an entity.
## How it works
1. Loads the entity, its module, the guide status, and existing `aisuggestion` records. 2. Renders the template named after the current step. 3. With no suggestions, runs `question_create_suggestions`. Otherwise moves to `question_ask`.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `entityid`: Id of the entity - `entitymoduleid`: Module id of the entity
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `entity`, `entitymodule`, `statuses`, `suggestions`
## Implementation
- Bean `questionsSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.QuestionsSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: searchingChatSkill description: Runs the conversational search flow: parses what the user wants, searches modules, and adds related semantic results. ---
# Searching Chat
Runs the conversational search flow: parses what the user wants, searches modules, and adds related semantic results.
## When to use
- The user asks the assistant to find assets or records.
## How it works
1. Does different work depending on the automation step id: 2. `chat_searching_welcome`: renders the welcome with the search schema, then `search_parse`. 3. `search_parse`: calls the thinking LLM to parse the request into search tables and keywords. If it cannot, replies conversationally. 4. `search_tables`: renders the table results and keeps them as a message prefix, then `search_semantic`. 5. `search_semantic`: adds semantic matches for the keywords, then returns to `search_parse`. 6. `view_related_record*`: renders related records.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `userquery`: The search request text, set from the user's message
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `userquery`, `semanticquery`, the parsed search parameters, and rendered results
## Implementation
- Bean `searchingSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.SearchingSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`
